walk_east_start.label: Walk - Start
walk_east_start.description: Bai Mitko shifts out of his standing pose and commits his weight into the first east-facing steps.

walk_east_loop.label: Walk - Loop
walk_east_loop.description: The repeatable middle section of Bai Mitko's east-facing walk, used while he crosses longer distances.

walk_east_short.label: Walk - Short
walk_east_short.description: A compact east-facing walk cycle for short movements where the full start-loop-stop sequence would feel too long.

walk_east_stop.label: Walk - Stop
walk_east_stop.description: Bai Mitko slows from his east-facing walk and settles back into a stable standing pose.

idle_east_1.label: Idle - Variant 1
idle_east_1.description: A one-shot east-facing idle performance used by the automatic idle pool before returning to the neutral stance.

idle_east_2.label: Idle - Variant 2
idle_east_2.description: A second one-shot east-facing idle performance that adds variety while Bai Mitko is waiting.

idle_east_3.label: Idle - Variant 3
idle_east_3.description: A third one-shot east-facing idle performance selected automatically during inactive moments.

idle_east_4.label: Idle - Variant 4
idle_east_4.description: A fourth one-shot east-facing idle performance that breaks up repeated neutral poses.

idle_east_5.label: Idle - Variant 5
idle_east_5.description: A fifth one-shot east-facing idle performance used as part of the character's randomized idle behavior.

idle_east_6.label: Idle - Variant 6
idle_east_6.description: A sixth one-shot east-facing idle performance that returns cleanly to Bai Mitko's neutral stance.

talk_east_long_1.label: Talk - Long Sentence
talk_east_long_1.description: An east-facing speaking performance timed for a longer sentence, with broader sustained conversational movement.

talk_east_long_2.label: Talk - Short Sentence
talk_east_long_2.description: An east-facing speaking performance for a short sentence, ending sooner than the long dialogue variant.

talk_east_short_1.label: Talk - Single Word
talk_east_short_1.description: A brief east-facing speaking gesture intended for a single word or very short reply.

reject_east_1.label: Reject Action
reject_east_1.description: Bai Mitko gives a negative or refusing response when the player tries an action that he will not perform.

look_into_distance_east_1.label: Look Into the Distance
look_into_distance_east_1.description: Bai Mitko shades his eyes and looks into the distance with a slightly confused expression.

take_east_forward_default.label: Take Object - Forward
take_east_forward_default.description: Bai Mitko reaches forward to collect an object; currently staged for taking the unpaid bills in the apartment.

opens_window.label: Open Apartment Window
opens_window.description: Bai Mitko approaches and opens the apartment window as part of the window interaction.

walk_north_loop.label: Walk - Away / Back
walk_north_loop.description: Owner-supplied genuine rear-facing shuffle, 64 x 56 ms = 3.584 s; local runtime review, with same-source settling. Not publication-approved.

walk_south_loop.label: Walk - Toward / Front
walk_south_loop.description: Owner-supplied genuine front-facing shuffle, 64 x 59 ms = 3.776 s; local runtime review, with same-source settling. Not publication-approved.
